## 🔐 Rollback Procedures

### If Architectural Changes Cause Issues

#### Option 1: Hard Reset (Complete revert)
```bash
git reset --hard phase-17-holistic-alignment-pre-architecture-changes
```
**Effect**: Local repository returns to exact state of this tag
**Use Case**: When changes must be completely discarded

#### Option 2: Create Branch (Safe branch point)
```bash
git checkout -b rollback-from-arch-changes phase-17-holistic-alignment-pre-architecture-changes
```
**Effect**: New branch created at this checkpoint
**Use Case**: When you want to preserve both versions for comparison

#### Option 3: View Tag Details
```bash
git show phase-17-holistic-alignment-pre-architecture-changes
```
**Effect**: Display commit and tag information
**Use Case**: For audit trail and documentation
